name: CGRateS
description: Real-time Online/Offline Charging System (OCS) for Telecom & ISP environments. High performance (5000+ req/s), with rating engine, CDR logging, fraud detection, and microservices architecture.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile in data/docker directory. Community Docker images: lmangani/cgrates-docker and slegs/cgrates-docker with presets for Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS, Kamailio.

eval_notes: Production-grade telecom billing system with 493 stars. DiameterAgent and RadiusAgent interfaces enable realistic charging and rating evaluation scenarios. Integrates with major SIP servers.
